instruction: Use Jade to open the raw XRD file 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\dependencies\Jade\WRT-ZSX-5.txt', analyze the diffraction peaks and find the best matching phase from the database. Export the corresponding PDF card to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\WRT_PDF1.txt'. Then open Origin, import 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\WRT_PDF1.txt' and 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\dependencies\Jade\WRT-ZSX-5.txt', set sample labels to ['WRTZSX5'] and PDF card labels to ['PDF#99-0073'], plot an XRD diffraction matching figure with HKL peak annotations and sample/PDF labels, and save the figure to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\WRT_XRD.png'.

config.note: Wait for Jade to fully load
